[i][b]呑噬传说鱼王[/b][/i]
通过鱼王获得不同的能力，通过对应二代可以强化或者延伸能力
使你在钓到某种鱼王后可以钓到对应的鱼王二代，即使你没有接到特别任务板的大家族任务。[u][i][b]鱼王或二代总共每年可以钓到一条[/b][/i][/u]


[b][i]传说之鱼[/i][/b]：吃下以后，你的下一次种植将无视季节限制，可以种下其他季节的作物。种下的作物可以在温室里一样跨季保留和生长，即使是冬天。单次收获作物将在收货后自动补种并继承效果
[b][i]传说之鱼二代[/i][/b]：重复获得能力


[b][i]绯红鱼 [/i][/b]：使你可以在持有武器或镰刀时蓄力攻击，每种武器的攻击不同
剑：造成150%伤害，攻击范围更大，并造成10%吸血
锤子：造成150%伤害，与右键重击相同，但不会击退怪物
匕首：125%伤害，向前方冲刺，蓄力时按右键冲刺的更远且判定更宽，过程中无敌，并具有双倍暴击率
镰刀：造成150%伤害，攻击周围一圈
[b][i]绯红鱼之子[/i][/b]：第1-3条分别可增加10%伤害第4条可以让你的攻击对敌人施加永久的点燃效果，每秒5%最大生命值，并且会在死
亡时爆炸，就类似于燃烧弹戒指的效果


[i][b]鮟鱇鱼[/b][/i]：按右键可以收获和填充周围8格的机器
[b][i]雌鮟鱇鱼[/i][/b]：第1、2、3条使分别增加0.5移动速度，第4条将扫描转变为连锁，可以连锁采集和填充。第5条将连锁转变为升级版扫描，距离+1，此后吃可以在连锁和升级版扫描之间切换

[b][i]
冰川鱼[/i][/b]：获得一个可以变化为的镐子、斧子、镰刀、锄头、水壶、淘盘六种形态的六相冰，手持六相冰右键可以按顺序切换形态（当你把淘盘形态戴在头上时，会变成可爱的猫耳鸭舌帽）（右上角显示下一个形态）
[b][i]小冰川鱼[/i][/b]：每条提升除镰刀外工具的品质，并在第4条时升级镰刀（升级会按普通→金→铱依次进行）
[b][i]进化[/i][/b]：向镰刀形态锻造三个银河之魂以升级镰刀，向其他工具形态锻造银河之魂以为其附魔，附魔与原版一致

[b][i]
变种鲤鱼[/i][/b]：放入鱼塘可以生产鱼籽，鱼籽吃下后记录当前位置（如果误食本体，可以重新钓取）
[b][i]放射性鲤鱼[/i][/b]：放入鱼塘可以生产鱼籽，鱼籽吃下后可以传送到记录的位置
[line]
[center][i][b]The programming and translation for this mod were entirely completed by ChatGPT.[/b][/i][/center]

[i][b]Devouring Legendary Fish[/b][/i]
Gain unique permanent abilities by consuming the Legendary Fish, then strengthen and expand those abilities by consuming their corresponding Legendary Successors.
After catching a Legendary Fish, you will also be able to catch its corresponding successor in later years, even without accepting the [b]Extended Family[/b] quest from the Special Orders board.
[i][b]You may naturally catch only one fish from each Legendary Fish / Successor pair per year.[/b][/i]

[i][b]Legend[/b][/i]
After consuming the [b]Legend[/b], the next crop you plant will ignore seasonal restrictions, allowing you to plant crops from any season.
Crops planted with this effect can survive and continue growing across seasons just like crops in the Greenhouse, including during winter.
Single-harvest crops will automatically be replanted after harvesting and will retain this effect.
[i][b]Legend II[/b][/i]
Grants additional uses of the ability.

[i][b]Crimsonfish[/b][/i]
Allows you to charge attacks while holding a weapon or scythe. Each weapon type gains a different charged attack:
[b]Sword:[/b]
Deals [b]150% damage[/b], has a larger attack area, and restores health equal to [b]10% of the damage dealt[/b].
[b]Club:[/b]
Deals [b]150% damage[/b]. Functions similarly to the normal right-click special attack, but does not knock enemies away.
[b]Dagger:[/b]
Deals [b]125% damage[/b] and dashes forward. Pressing right-click while charging performs a longer dash with a wider hitbox. You are invincible during the dash, and the attack has [b]double critical-hit chance[/b].
[b]Scythe:[/b]
Deals [b]150% damage[/b] in a full circle around you.
[i][b]Son of Crimsonfish[/b][/i]
The first three increase your damage by [b]10% each[/b].
The fourth causes your attacks to permanently ignite enemies, dealing [b]5% of their maximum health per second[/b].
Burning enemies explode when they die, similar to the effect of the [b]Napalm Ring[/b].

[i][b]Angler[/b][/i]
Press right-click to perform a single scan of the [b]8 surrounding tiles[/b], collecting from or filling nearby machines.
[i][b]Ms. Angler[/b][/i]
The first, second, and third each permanently increase movement speed by [b]0.5[/b].
The fourth transforms the scan into a [b]chain effect[/b], allowing connected machines to be collected from or filled in sequence.
The fifth transforms the chain effect into an [b]upgraded scan[/b], increasing its range by 1 tile.
Afterward, consuming another Ms. Angler switches between [b]Chain Mode[/b] and [b]Upgraded Scan Mode[/b].

[i][b]Glacierfish[/b][/i]
Grants [b]Six-Phase Ice[/b], a special tool that can transform between six forms:
[b]Pickaxe / Axe / Scythe / Hoe / Watering Can / Pan[/b]
Right-click while holding Six-Phase Ice to switch to the next form.
When the [b]Pan form[/b] is worn on your head, it becomes a cute [b]cat-ear baseball cap[/b].
The icon in the upper-right corner shows which form will come next.
[i][b]Glacierfish Jr.[/b][/i]
Each one increases the quality of every Six-Phase Ice tool form except the Scythe.
The fourth also upgrades the Scythe.
Scythe upgrades always progress in order:
[b]Normal → Golden → Iridium[/b]

[i][b]Evolution[/b][/i]
Forge [b]three Galaxy Souls[/b] into the Scythe form to upgrade it.
Forge a Galaxy Soul into any other tool form to enchant that tool.
Tool enchantments work the same way as their vanilla counterparts.

[i][b]Mutant Carp[/b][/i]
Place the [b]Mutant Carp[/b] in a Fish Pond to produce Roe.
Eating its Roe records your current location.
If you accidentally eat the Mutant Carp itself, it can be caught again.
[i][b]Radioactive Carp[/b][/i]
Place the [b]Radioactive Carp[/b] in a Fish Pond to produce Roe.
Eating its Roe teleports you to the location previously recorded with Mutant Carp Roe.
